title: MiaMe migration phase manifest
description: The manifest is a CONTRACT, not a log. scripts/migrations-check.mjs validates every phase against this file, and scripts/migrations-apply.mjs refuses any status that is not `pending` before it opens a database connection.

status.description: applied = in the ledger. pending = approved to apply, THE ONLY status the applier accepts. hold = real work, product decision missing. superseded = a later migration already does this. replay-only = needed to build from empty, never applied live. foreign = belongs to another database.

supersededBy.description: Required when status is `superseded`: the migration filename that replaced this one. A phase marked superseded with nothing to point at is an assertion, not a record.

ledger.description: The version production actually carries. NOT always the filename prefix.
